title: Podocytopathy types & MCD causes/presentation
guide: Definition and presentation list, the without/with-podocytopenia split (MCD no CKD risk; FSGS >2/3; MN 1/3; DN), MCD 2° causes (NSAIDs MCD>MN vs gold MN>MCD, interferon α; atopy/post-immunization; Hodgkin's/Sezary/CLL) and the 100/0 rule with absent HTN/AKI/microhematuria.

title: FSGS causes, circulating factors & genetic forms
guide: 2° FSGS drug/infection/misc lists, suPAR + CLC-1 as circulating permeability factor, congenital NS genetics (NPHS1-nephrin birth/DMS; NPHS2-podocin 3-5 yrs; α actin 4/TRPC 6 AD adolescents) with transplant-only Rx, and 2° perihilar hyperfiltration mechanics with ACE (−).

title: 75/25 rule & MN causes
guide: FSGS 75/25 rule with the no-immunosuppression instruction, the full MN 2° cause tree (drugs incl. mercury; HBV/syphilis/schistosomiasis; SLE V, RA amyloid>MN, sarcoid/IgG4 tubulointerstitial, rare trio; colorectal adenocarcinoma), anti-PLA2R, 70/30 rule with maximum thrombosis, d-penicillamine note and adult-MN/child-MCD mnemonics.

title: MCD features, podocyte changes & treatment flowchart
sec: MCD Features, Podocyte Changes & Relapse · p765
guide: Lipoid nephrosis with 90%/10-15% shares, boys>girls peak 2-7 yrs, non-selective proteinuria vs selective albumin/transferrin, CD80/angiopoietin-like 4 charge loss, URTI/LRTI relapse with 0.5 mg/kg prednisolone, the 4-week steroid flowchart (5-10% resistance → biopsy/genetics → CNI or transplant; 25/25/50 responder split), FRNS cyclophosphamide and SDNS MMF-best/rituximab.

title: Biopsy & IF: MCD, IgM nephropathy, FSGS
sec: Biopsy & IF: MCD, IgM Nephropathy, FSGS · p766
guide: Normal LM/IF in MCD; IgM nephropathy variant (mesangial expansion, IgM +ve, poorer prognosis); FSGS Apo L1 and 70% CKD by 10 yrs; focal/segmental definitions; podocytopenia-synechiae sclerosis chain; focal IgM ± C3 with 2° IF negative; 1 mg/kg/day × 4 months ladder to transplant and transplant-recurrence FSGS.

title: FSGS histological variants
guide: Classical, 2° perihilar, tip variant (tip-only, MCD-like, good) and collapsing (worst; HIV/HIVAN, heroin, IFN α, parvo B19, pamidronate; pseudocrescent podocyte hypertrophy, dilated tubules/microcysts, ER cisternae = IFN footprints) plus the true-crescent note and SLE/collapsing IFN-footprint pair.

title: MN antigens, rule of thirds & biopsy/IF/EM
sec: MN Antigens & Rule of Thirds · p768
guide: The antigen road-map (1959 Heymann → 2009 PLA2R → 2014 THSD7A → 2019 exostosin → 2020 NELL-1/sema 3b/PCDH7 → 2021 NCAM1/HTRA-1/contactin-1), bovine extrinsic antigen, 1/3 outcomes, uniform GBM thickening, the 1° vs 2° IF table (IgG4 vs IgG1-3, full house, PLA2R, mesangial staining) and subepithelial deposits/spikes with 2° mesangial extension.

title: MN figures & treatment
guide: Figure labels (thin vs thick walls, granular IF, spikes schematic) and both treatment arms: 70% NS with modified Ponticelli (steroids 1/3/5, cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg 2/4/6, abrupt stop; rituximab on failure) vs 30% asymptomatic (ACE/ARBs, salt restriction, 1 gm/kg/day protein).
